schema.text: When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians make you feel unsafe?

ar.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: عند ركوب الدراجة، هل يُشعرك السلوك غير الآمن ممن يقودون أو يركبون الدراجات أو يمشون بعدم الأمان؟

de.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: Fühlen Sie sich beim Radfahren durch unsicheres Verhalten von Fahrenden oder zu Fuß Gehenden unsicher?

en.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians make you feel unsafe?

fa.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: هنگام دوچرخه‌سواری، آیا رفتار ناایمن رانندگان، دوچرخه‌سواران یا عابران پیاده باعث می‌شود احساس ناامنی کنید؟

fr.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, vous sentez-vous en danger à cause de comportements dangereux de personnes qui conduisent, qui roulent ou qui marchent ?

hu.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: Kerékpározás közben a járművezetők, kerékpárosok vagy gyalogosok veszélyes viselkedése miatt érzi magát veszélyben?

it.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: Quando vai in bici, i comportamenti pericolosi di chi guida, di chi pedala o di chi va a piedi ti fanno sentire in pericolo?

tr.#When you cycle, does unsafe behaviour f: Bisiklet sürerken sürücülerin veya yayaların güvensiz davranışları kendinizi güvensiz hissetmenize neden oluyor mu?
